<section class="uiao-section problem" id="canon-invariants">
  <div class="uiao-overview-section">
    <p class="section-label">Canon Invariants</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">Every document inherits the same canon discipline.</h2>
    <p class="section-body" style="margin-bottom:1rem;">These invariants flow from the UIAO canon into every page in the portal.</p>
    <ul class="problem-list">
      <li><strong>Boundary:</strong>&nbsp;<code>gcc-moderate</code> unless explicitly noted.</li>
      <li><strong>Commercial cloud exception:</strong>&nbsp;Amazon Connect Contact Center only.</li>
      <li><strong>Identity model:</strong>&nbsp;object identity only; no person identity.</li>
      <li><strong>SSOT discipline:</strong>&nbsp;adapters consume and emit; they never mutate SSOT.</li>
      <li><strong>Certificate anchoring:</strong>&nbsp;every transaction is certificate-anchored.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

    <p class="section-body" style="margin-bottom:1rem;">All documents carry YAML frontmatter that traces to a specific canon source in <code>src/uiao/canon/</code>. Drift is detected by the <code>uiao.tools.sync_canon</code> module and surfaced as <code>canon-sync</code>-labeled PRs. This site is sourced from <code>/docs/customer-documents/</code> in the unified monorepo; the directory tree is documented in <a href="TREE.html">TREE.qmd</a>.</p>
